snapshot_scope: Verified inventory counts from the maintainer's central PostgreSQL reference database; this manifest exposes metadata only, not raw private database rows.

datasets.name: FAOSTAT QCL — Crops and Livestock Products
datasets.caveat: Coverage varies by country, item and year. This source is national-level history, not district-level observation.

datasets.name: IFPRI MAPSPAM 2020 v2r2
caveats: 2020 is a single reference year, not an annual time series or current-year measurement.
Grid cells are approximately 9.3 km at the equator; this is not field-scale data.
Yield must be aggregated as a harvested-area-weighted mean, never by summing yield values.
ADM0, ADM1 and ADM2 are separate hierarchy summaries and must not be added as if they were mutually exclusive areas.
Boundary-vintage or parent-child reconciliation warnings must be preserved; missing raster coverage is NULL, not zero.

datasets.name: CROPGRIDS v1.08
datasets.caveat: Project catalog entry only; its files are not counted in the 838,919 imported rows.

models.global_faostat_baseline: Ridge with expanding-window validation, compared against Persistence
models.status: Implemented research algorithms; not a validated universal global crop model.

private_data_note: The public GitHub Pages site displays this aggregate inventory snapshot. It does not expose the central PostgreSQL records or authenticated user uploads. Full country/item series and MAPSPAM rows need the protected FastAPI/PostgreSQL service.
